title: Embedding Stability Prober and Synthetic Perturbation Suite
creator: Marisol Ortega
description: Build a reusable evaluation harness that probes embedding accuracy and reranker stability by applying synthetic perturbations and measuring offline quality metrics. The harness will produce nightly drift signals, deterministic canary runs for new model/quantization combos, and a small fast-mode that runs on PRs for regressions. Focus areas: (1) perturbation generator (typos, paraphrase substitutions, reorder, truncation, noise injection), (2) stable holdout/anchor corpora and versioned gold sets, (3) metric suite (MRR, p@k, cosine/L2 distribution shift, calibration gap, KS/stat tests), (4) orchestration and scaling for large corpora with memory-efficient batching and sharding across workers.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible perturbation pipeline that outputs N variants per example with seeded randomness
Nightly job that runs on full goldset and produces time-series metrics and drift score into Observability dashboard
PR-level fast-mode that runs a 500-sample subset in < 8 minutes and fails CI on >5% regression in MRR
Canary workflow that replays live traffic-rerank snapshots against candidate model and produces comparison report
Alerts wired: drift_score > 0.25 OR p@1 drop > 3% triggers PagerDuty and creates a ticket
technical_notes: Perturbations: character-level typos, swap neighboring tokens, controlled paraphrase using a small paraphrase model, doc truncation at head/tail/center, random stopword removal, numeric perturbation
Metrics: MRR@10, p@1/p@5, average cosine similarity delta, embedding norm distribution delta, KS test for distribution shift, population covariance eigenvalue drift
Scalability: runner uses Apache Beam-like map-reduce stage; each worker processes batches of 1024 embeddings and uses mmap for goldset vectors to minimize RAM
Determinism: all RNG seeded, perturbation seed derived from example id + suite id to ensure reproducible runs
Storage: goldset artifacts versioned in s3://redwood-emb-goldsets/<release>/ and checksummed; metadata JSON per goldset
Performance: aim for nightly run of 250k pairs within 6 hours on existing infra (estimated 20 workers), fast-mode for PRs uses 500 samples and 4 workers
implementation_plan: Week 1: design perturbation grammar, define goldset selection criteria and sampling strata
Week 2: implement perturbation generator library + unit tests and seed determinism
Week 3: integrate vectorized metric library, implement KS and covariance drift calculation
Week 4: orchestrate nightly job, add alert thresholds and push metrics to Grafana/Prometheus
Week 5: PR fast-mode integration into CI, document runbook and dashboard panels
Post-Launch: iterate thresholds based on baseline runs and add canary traffic replay capability
runbook_high_level: When drift alert fires: inspect recent nightly diffs, check model/version, reproduce perturbation sample locally
If regression confirmed: run canary replay with live reranker snapshot, assess rollback vs patch
For false positives: adjust sampling strata or tweak alert thresholds and note change in runbook
